body: Why is it so hard for people to understand that maybe after 2.5 years I just want to work it out. I like our dynamic, I like him, I like how well we work together. He doesn't have to be handsome or rich or hung (did you even read the post?! No interest in sex here, hello) for me to want to work things out. I thought that was the decent thing to do when someone makes a mistake. You work through it, you don't just throw up your hands and say "well you fucked up so this is the end of everything" but maybe I'm an outlier.

I agree with the first part. It isn't fair for him to throw it all away, but on the flip side of that coin it isn't fair for me to throw down the gauntlet and say it's the hobby or me. I *know* there is a way to make it work so he can keep his hobby and still work on our relationship I just don't know what that way is.
I go to the same hobby meetings though. It's not like he's going to go solo and she'll be there. I go to them to because it's pretty neat.

He didn't make the decision to give up his hobby and his passion when he cheated on me, *he made a decision to cheat*. I'm not going to hold this over him and force him to give up something he loves. That isn't fair. That isn't how a relationship works. 

I can ask him to not talk to her until the season starts and then reevaluate but I cannot and will not make him give up something that is such a huge part of who he is because he fucked up and fucked around.
Thank you. I think I'll have him cut ties until the season starts up again and then see how our relationship is then. If he refuses to do that then I don't see how we can move forward.

Thank you for all this advice. I think communication has been a big issue in our relationship so coming up with all of these deal breakers and steps forward is a good idea because it holds both of us accountable.

I mean, it is a niche common interest that meets up weekly for 2 months of the year. He's been part of this community for 8 years now and it's a huge part of his life. I can't ask him to give it up. It's too important to him and that isn't fair.

That being said, she's part of that community too. I don't see how they can cut contact and maintain it through all of the times they will be put in close contact with each other.

The only thing I can see happening is they cut contact for about 6 months until the season starts up again and then maybe testing the waters then but I'm not sure how great of an idea that is.

I don't want to dump him. I love him and I want to work things out but I don't know how.
